Drafto does not collect, store, or transmit any analytics, tracking, or personal data. There are no user accounts, profiling, or remote servers. All your notes, to-dos, bookmarks, and settings reside strictly on your local device.

Drafto connects to the internet exclusively when you save or view a bookmark, solely to download website favicons and OpenGraph preview cards (title, description, and thumbnail). No personal information or identifiers are ever transmitted.

Because Drafto has no cloud storage or remote servers, the security, storage, and sharing of any exported files (master ZIP backups, Markdown notes, or HTML bookmarks) is entirely under your custody and responsibility.
